# Upstream sources

`WLASL/` is the Git submodule for [dxli94/WLASL](https://github.com/dxli94/WLASL), pinned to `ac00e6be631c1a2a486621b65f202219f3964d6b`.

```bash
git submodule update --init --recursive
```

The submodule preserves the upstream authors, annotation files, example models, download scripts, and `start_kit/C-UDA-1.0.pdf`. Review the upstream README and agreement before using its data. The upstream README states academic and computational use only and prohibits commercial usage.

Citation supplied by the upstream project

```bibtex
@inproceedings{li2020word,
  title={Word-level Deep Sign Language Recognition from Video: A New Large-scale Dataset and Methods Comparison},
  author={Li, Dongxu and Rodriguez, Cristian and Yu, Xin and Li, Hongdong},
  booktitle={The IEEE Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision},
  pages={1459--1469},
  year={2020}
}
```
